name: aveon-editor-monorepo
description: Aveon Editor - a modern rich text editor engine with a CKEditor 5 compatible architecture and API surface

scripts.build:angular: cd apps/cms-angular && npx ng build aveon-angular && npx ng build
scripts.pack:release: npm run build && cd packages/aveon-editor && npm pack --pack-destination ../../release && cd ../../apps/cms-angular && npx ng build aveon-angular && cd dist/aveon-angular && npm pack --pack-destination ../../../../release
